content: English spellings with weighted word counts only; no sentence text is packaged.

sources.name: SCOWL (Spell Checker Oriented Word Lists) 2020.12.07

sources.name: Mozilla Common Voice English sentence text
sources.note: Only weighted word counts are packaged. One sentence in forty (by SHA-256 of its text) is held out; 2,000 of them are tests/data/english_heldout_sentences.txt.

sources.name: Tatoeba English sentences
sources.note: Only weighted word counts are packaged. One sentence in forty is held out; 2,000 of them are tests/data/english_heldout_tatoeba.txt.

sources.name: English Wikinews article dump
sources.note: Main-namespace articles, wikitext stripped, split into sentences. Only weighted word counts are packaged. One sentence in forty is held out; 2,000 of them are tests/data/english_heldout_wikinews.txt.

evaluation.tests/data/english_misspellings.tsv: Project-authored misspellings, slips and words that must stay (MIT).
evaluation.tests/data/english_heldout_sentences.txt: Held-out Common Voice English sentences (CC0 1.0), never counted.
evaluation.tests/data/english_heldout_tatoeba.txt: Held-out Tatoeba English sentences (CC BY 2.0 FR, Tatoeba contributors), never counted.
evaluation.tests/data/english_heldout_wikinews.txt: Held-out English Wikinews sentences (CC BY 2.5 / 4.0, Wikinews contributors), never counted.

normalization: Weighted counts are scaled to 17,339,963 words (the Common Voice-only total) so the speller's count thresholds keep their meaning.
